result.instructions: Tools for ExakTime (Arcoro Time), hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who worked on the Main Street job last week and how many overtime hours did they log?"; "Which employees have not signed off the current pay period?"; "Show pending time off requests for this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ExakTime (Arcoro Time) data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run exaktime_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run exaktime_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run exaktime_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. exaktime_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: exaktime_query_odata
tools.title: Query any OData entity set
tools.description: Read-only OData query over any Arcoro data warehouse entity set, for questions the other tools do not cover (equipment, expenses, users, time records by hour group, learning, performance, recruiting, benefits...). Entity sets start with Dw, e.g. DwUsers, DwEquipments, DwExpenses, DwCostCodes, DwLocations, DwTimeRecordByHourGroups, DwEmploymentStatusHistories. Full list: https://my.arcoro.com/api/odata ; schema: https://api.arcoro.com/odata/$metadata. $filter uses OData v4 syntax, e.g. startswith(LastName,'Sm') and IsActive eq true. Source: the read-only OData data warehouse, refreshed nightly, so today's entries may not show until tomorrow. Page with skip/next_skip. GET /odata/{EntitySet}.

skip.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: exaktime_create_job
tools.title: Create job
tools.description: WRITE: create a job (project) that employees can book time to. Identifier must be unique. The job appears in Arcoro right away; it can be deactivated again with exaktime_update_job (there is no delete). POST /v1/Time/Jobs.

is_active.description: Active jobs can be selected for time entry.

parent_job_id.description: Parent job id, to create a sub-job.

location_ids.description: Location ids the job is limited to (exaktime_list_locations). Setting them turns off 'available at all locations'.

all_locations.description: true: the job is available at every location; false: only at location_ids.

tools.name: exaktime_update_job
tools.title: Update job
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing job (rename it, set dates, assign locations, or set is_active=false to close it). Only the fields you pass change (null clears a nullable field); the tool reads the job first and sends the full object, because Arcoro replaces the job on PUT. Two edits to the same job at the same moment can overwrite each other: run them one after the other. PUT /v1/Time/Jobs/{id}.

is_active.description: Active jobs can be selected for time entry.

start_date.description: Job start date, or null to clear it.

end_date.description: Job end date, or null to clear it.

department_id.description: Department id, or null to clear it.

parent_job_id.description: Parent job id, or null to detach the job from its parent.

anyOf.description: Parent job id, to create a sub-job.

location_ids.description: Location ids the job is limited to (exaktime_list_locations). Setting them turns off 'available at all locations'.

all_locations.description: true: the job is available at every location; false: only at location_ids.

tools.name: exaktime_create_cost_code
tools.title: Create cost code
tools.description: WRITE: create a cost code (phase or work activity) that time can be booked against. The name must be unique. It can be deactivated again with exaktime_update_cost_code (there is no delete). POST /v1/Time/CostCodes.

display_option.description: Default: selectable by users. System: system-defined, hidden from users.

tools.name: exaktime_update_cost_code
tools.title: Update cost code
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing cost code (rename it, change its cost type, or set is_active=false to retire it). Only the fields you pass change; the tool reads the cost code first and sends the full object. PUT /v1/Time/CostCodes/{id}.

display_option.description: Default: selectable by users. System: system-defined, hidden from users.

tools.name: exaktime_create_location
tools.title: Create location
tools.description: WRITE: create a location (job site or office). Add the address and/or latitude and longitude so geofencing and maps work. It can be deactivated again with exaktime_update_location (there is no delete). POST /v1/Common/Locations.

is_time_and_attendance.description: Employees can clock in at this location.

onboarding_business_unit_id.description: Onboarding business unit id; Arcoro requires it for an office when Onboarding business units are enabled.

address.description: Street address; every field except address_line2 is required by Arcoro.

tools.name: exaktime_update_location
tools.title: Update location
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing location (rename, move, new address, or set is_active=false to retire it). Only the fields you pass change; the tool reads the location first and sends the full object. PUT /v1/Common/Locations/{id}.

onboarding_business_unit_id.description: Onboarding business unit id; Arcoro requires it for an office when Onboarding business units are enabled.

address.description: Street address; every field except address_line2 is required by Arcoro.
